utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday works for me, as long as we keep it light for a weeknight. I’m still waiting on the title and time, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the title and time too—Mina’s on chapter 4, Mara’s thinking 6:30 to 8:00, and Ben is just about finished with the memoir.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds manageable—6:30 to 8:00 could work if the book’s not too heavy. I’ll wait for the title and Leo’s time, then I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with snacks, book ideas, or even lend a few tools and supplies if the book club needs them. And I can pass along the meeting time too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — please pass along that the book club meets Thursday at 7 PM. We’re reading The Little Prince this month.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll pass along Thursday at 7 PM and that you’re reading *The Little Prince*.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on Thursday, and they’re going with a lighter pick this time. I’ll ask around and let Pia know the title once I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll remind everyone it’s on Thursday. Glad Cleo has the supplies ready too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, that helps! I’ll see if I can pin down the title too and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thursday’s book club is all set—I’ve got the supplies ready. Oren’s coming, Rosa’s helping, and I’ll make sure we’ve got snacks, tea, and a few extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll see if I can make it to Quinn’s meeting.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Uli—Thursday works for the book club, so if you can make Quinn’s meeting too, that’d be lovely. I’ll keep the supplies ready and the extra chairs set aside.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thursday’s the book club night, and Dane’s running late again. I still need to let Pia know the title and time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — send Pia the title and time once it’s confirmed. Thursday at 7 PM is the meeting, and I still want the book title sent over too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll send Pia the title and Thursday at 7 PM, and I’ll keep an eye out for Dane.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mina said they’re reading "The Midnight Library" this month, and I heard they’re leaning toward a mystery next time. If you want, Gus said he can bring a couple ideas too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — we’re reading a mystery this week, and Faye’s in too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh nice, that matches what I heard. If the book club needs anything, Gus can also lend a few tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can grab the snacks and a few extra chairs, and Rosa’s checklist sounds perfect. I’m glad we’re starting with a short mystery too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Let’s keep it simple for now, and I’ll let Gus know if we need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll handle the snacks and chairs, and we can keep the rest simple for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably be late to the book club again, but I’m caught up enough to jump in. Good to know Hana’s keeping track of everything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries — the book club is still at 6:30 to 8:00, so that should work for school nights. I’ll text Bo the title and time now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks — I’ll try to slip in when I can. And yeah, text Bo the details so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—I’ll send out the invite today with the Thursday evening time and the address. Mara already offered to help with snacks or book ideas, and Uli’s checking if they can make it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Thursday evening at the address works for me. I’ll bring the mystery novel and keep our discussion question ready so everyone gets a turn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Opal — that sounds perfect. I’ll send the invite today so everyone has the Thursday evening details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I know it’s a mystery novel this week, but I still need the exact club title. Rey said they could check it for me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, could you ask Gus too? I’m still trying to get the meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can ask Gus while I’m out. I still need the exact title anyway, so I’ll see if he knows it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely—I’m happy to help with snacks or book ideas. Since it’s already evening, we should keep it from running too late so Faye can make it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this Thursday, and we’re reading "The Midnight Library" this month. Let’s keep the pick simple so it’s easy for everyone to get into.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—keeping it simple sounds great, and I can bring snacks or suggest a few easy discussion ideas.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Oren’s all set, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’m all set for Thursday. Vik’s hosting, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — so you’re confirmed for Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s on Thursday, and they’re picking a lighter read this time — I’ll ask around and tell Pia once I know the title.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — Thursday at the cafe still works, and I’ll keep the checklist ready with snacks, tea, a few extra chairs, and that short mystery.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that sounds set — I’ll ask around and let Pia know the title as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re reading "The Midnight Library" this month. Ira’s going to swing by the bookstore later, so we can see what looks good.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, nice — Thursday should be fun, and I’ll be there for the meeting. Vik’s hosting, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, Thursday works, and Vik’s hosting this time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday still works for me, but I’m hoping it’s a lighter pick for a weeknight. I’ll wait to hear the title and time before I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a couple lighter book ideas for Thursday, and if you need anything else for the club, I’ve got some tools and supplies to lend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful, thanks — I’m still waiting on the title and time so I can plan Thursday properly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re set for Thursday — I’ve got the supplies ready. Oren’s coming, Rosa’s helping, and Vik’s on reminder duty.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—what’s the exact book club title?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s the Thursday book club meeting—just our neighborhood reading group.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s on Thursday, and Dane might be a bit late. Opal’s bringing the mystery novel, and I’m still trying to pin down the title details for Pia.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely — I can help with snacks or toss out a few book ideas. And since it’s in the evening, I hope it won’t run too late for Faye on a school night.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great — snacks are always welcome, and I’ll keep it in mind if we need to keep it a bit shorter for Faye.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can grab the snacks and extra chairs for the book club. Just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I might need the meeting time again, if that’s okay. Gus said he can pass it along if needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — just have Gus send it along, and I’ll be ready with the snacks and chairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: A mystery sounds fun to me too. Sounds like Opal’s got that one covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yep, I’m bringing the mystery novel, and Jules and I are lining up one discussion question for each book so everyone gets a turn.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, that sounds great. I’ll make sure to catch up on the reading so I’m not the one slowing us down.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send me the book title and time when you have it? I know Ben’s almost done with the memoir, and Jules is bringing a snack.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll send the title as soon as Oren checks the notes and lets me know. I’ve got this week’s mystery novel, and I’ll pass along the time too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — please send the title and time once Oren confirms the notes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll text you the book title and 6:30 to 8:00 time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Quinn — you’re sending everyone the invite today with the evening time and address, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — I’ll send the invite today with the Thursday evening time and the address.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just confirming that’s still going out today with the Thursday evening time and the address.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard they’re reading "The Midnight Library" this month. If the club wants, Gus can bring a couple ideas too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I’ll see if I can make it to Quinn’s meeting, and if I hear the title I’ll let Sam know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — if you do hear anything, let me know, and Gus can still help out with ideas or supplies if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, the book club is on Thursday, and I’ll remind everyone about the plan. Cleo has the supplies ready, and Oren will be there too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — please remind everyone it’s Thursday at 7 PM.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind everyone it’s Thursday at 7 PM.
